decision: Keep the trimmed regexp for the release. The tuned scanner is worth further evaluation for CSS with many duplicate URLs, but is not adopted: MDN allocation changes are small, all timing controls remain unresolved, and the prototype adds a separate fast path plus a regexp fallback.

harness/profile-pipeline.sh.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
source /mnt/e/tmp/wse-css-scan-mdn-20261003/env.sh
export WSE_FOCUSED_CASES=css-unique,css-duplicates
for pressure in 0 1; do
  export WSE_HEAP_PRESSURE=$pressure
  for round in 0 1 2; do
    for k in 0 1 2; do
      variant=$(( (k + round) % 3 ))
      name=scanner
      if [ "$variant" = 0 ]; then name=baseline; fi
      node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 /mnt/e/tmp/wse-css-scan-mdn-20261003/harness/pipeline.mjs "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-css-scan-mdn-20261003/variants/$name/lib/index.js" profile "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-css-scan-mdn-20261003/profiles/pipeline-p$pressure-r$round-v$variant" > "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-css-scan-mdn-20261003/logs/pipeline-p$pressure-r$round-v$variant.json"
    done
  done
done
